name: What is a final quality walkthrough in construction?

mainEntity.name: What is a final quality walkthrough in construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: A final quality walkthrough is a critical inspection conducted before project completion and client handover. It involves a thorough review of the completed construction against architectural plans, specifications, and quality standards. This process ensures all work is done correctly, identifies any deficiencies or punch list items, and confirms the project meets contractual obligations and client expectations. This is a key step for Frasheski Construction to ensure our high standards are met before client sign-off.
acceptedAnswer.description: A final quality walkthrough is an inspection before project completion to ensure all work meets plans, specifications, and quality standards, identifying any last deficiencies.
